item_short_desc: Rothco's Athletic Fit Security T-shirt is made from a super comfortable cotton/polyester fabric blend and features a 'Security' print on the front and back.
description: Rothco's Athletic Fit Security T-shirt is made from a super soft cotton/polyester fabric blend. This shirt features an updated Athletic fit which has a slightly smaller chest, smaller armholes, and a smaller sleeve opening. 'Security' is printed in white on the center chest as well as on the back of the t-shirt. Tagless label and inset collar offer maximum comfort no matter where you go.
